messages:
maria.product: Quick heads-up — I'm drafting the PRD for the audit / key management workstream. Need to capture security acceptance criteria for KMS/HSM, audit-log retention/export, and SOC2 evidence. @lukas.eng-security can you drop must-haves? We have a couple of customer asks already (one suggested 7y retention).

lukas.eng-security: Short list from sec POV: 1) CMK support via cloud KMS + auditable key usage logs, 2) HSM-backed keys for Private/VPC customers, 3) tamper-evident append-only audit logs (integrity checks/hashes), 4) configurable retention windows (90d default, up to 7y contract), 5) key rotation and emergency key-revocation procedures, 6) exportable signed log bundles for audits.

sophia.eng-platform: Implementation notes: BYOK and HSM ramps are non-trivial — provisioning, key import, and access policies need infra+ops workflows. Also we should decide if audit logs are stored in object storage with manifest+hash for immutability or in append-only DB. Cost & egress implications too.

andrew.legal: Legal/compliance constraints: SOC2 wants evidence of change control + retained logs for incidents. Default retention we can commit to 3 years in standard T&Cs, extended (up to 7y) via contract. For eDiscovery customers we need export format + chain-of-custody metadata. Also flag export encryption.

kai.eng-runtime: A couple of engineering flags: 1) we must redact PII before writing logs or support a split (raw encrypted logs + curated index), 2) long retention increases storage/index cost — consider metadata-only long-term retention, 3) KV cache & request traces can be large; decide whether to include full model IO in audit logs or just headers/hashes.

maria.product: Good — can you help me convert those into acceptance criteria we can paste into the PRD? I want concrete GIVEN/WHEN/THEN lines for sign-off. Also need to prioritize launch scope vs. stretch.

lukas.eng-security: Draft acceptance criteria (feel free to edit):
- GIVEN a customer with Redwood-managed keys, WHEN a model request is served, THEN the KMS must record a signed key-usage event with timestamp and request-id, and the event must be exportable for at least 90 days.
- GIVEN a Private/VPC customer who requests HSM-backed keys, WHEN keys are provisioned, THEN keys are stored/protected in FIPS 140-2 level-3 HSM and key import/export operations must require dual-operator approvals.
- GIVEN audit log storage, WHEN logs are written, THEN logs must be append-only with integrity hashes and support generating signed bundles for auditors.
- GIVEN a retention policy of X days (configurable), WHEN retention expires, THEN entries are deleted or moved to encrypted cold storage with an auditable tombstone.
- GIVEN a key rotation event, WHEN rotation completes, THEN system must record rotation metadata and make previous versions inaccessible for new encryptions but still retrievable for decryption of existing data per policy.

sophia.eng-platform: Proposed launch plan (MVP vs phases):
- MVP: Redwood-managed KMS integration, immutable audit logs with 90d retention, exportable signed bundles, basic SOC2 artifacts (process doc + sample logs).
- Phase 2: BYOK support + HSM option for Private customers, retention config UI/API (90d-7y), rotation automation.
- Phase 3: eDiscovery export tooling, WORM/object-store manifests, long-term metadata-only retention, per-customer retention overrides via contract.

deploy-bot: Reminder: security deploy window next Tue 02:00-04:00 UTC for infra changes. Please tag services needing maintenance. :bell:

andrew.legal: For PRD please include: required contractual language options for 3y vs 7y retention, SLA boundaries if we offer HSM (we may need extra SLAs for key availability), and a process for customers to request export + chain-of-custody evidence.

kai.eng-runtime: Edge cases to call out in PRD: customer requests cross-region key import, emergency key-rotation if a key is compromised, and log corruption detection & repair workflow. Also note cost tradeoffs for keeping full payloads.

maria.product: Awesome — I'll fold these into the PRD draft. Action items: Lukas — add threat model + acceptance test steps; Sophia — add infra design sketch + rollout ETA; Andrew — add clause text + SOC2 evidence checklist; Kai — supply recommended redaction rules. Target: PRD draft circulated to reviewers by EOD Friday. Thanks all :thumbsup:
